admitted_read: Load governed TRAIN through existing slurp_kb_rows. Exclude the whole utterance if any recording is in A or B; require exact remaining pool identity and snapshot membership before releasing text/labels. Do not read DEV/test content or results for authoring.
authoring_rules: Use support examples to explain semantics, ambiguity, inclusion and exclusion; do not copy TRAIN as memory.
Do not add rules extracted from DEV failures or task-score feedback.
Treat observed label/type co-occurrence as evidence, not an unconditional required-slot schema.
Only root-reviewed authored values enter the registered semantic builders and named store releases.
authority: Owner-approved task-specific, separate intent and slot knowledge construction; root native role integration decision.

outputs.material: English source text, token spans, entity types/fillers, intent, exact source IDs and group membership; no runtime release yet.
outputs.receipts: Create-only outer and two support construction rosters, source hash bindings, counts and decontamination receipt.

purpose: Prepare governed TRAIN support for stable intent boundaries and explanatory slot contracts; root authors and reviews final values.

selection.coverage: Report all observed intent/type relations and unsupported or sparse cases. Do not infer mandatory fields from frequency.
selection.intent_support: Take at most eight utterances per intent; retain all available when fewer than eight.
selection.ordering: Sort each group by SHA-256 of UTF-8 string semantic-authoring-v1: plus utterance_id; break ties by utterance_id.
selection.slot_support: Take at most three utterances per observed (intent,entity_type) pair; retain all available when fewer than three. Deduplicate selected utterances across pairs.
selection.source_bindings: Retain all recording IDs of each selected utterance; freeze separate exact construction rosters for the intent and slot support sets through core.roster.
